user.title: Modem Claro (experimental)
user.description: Username/password may be required even for setup if the modem's status pages show a login form; they also enable manual restart. Login sends credentials in an HTTP query over your LAN: use only on a trusted network. No automatic reboots occur.

error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address without a URL or path
error.cannot_connect: Could not read modem status pages. If the modem requests login, enter username and password.
